declared_before: any 2021-2025 or 2026 score of any P2 candidate was computed
base: P1 = FROZEN_P1 {sigma 15, tau 1.5, w 0.7, delta 6, cap inf, hfa 2, u0 14}, pool games, conference targets; not re-tuned
candidate: P2 = P1 + preseason prior (returning production percentPPA z, 4-yr recruiting points z, rp-dependent persistence) + innovation clip at clip*sqrt(S); forecast SD uses a separate sigma_pred (gain keeps sigma=15)
sigma_pred_grid: 11.0..16.0 step 0.5, tuned separately for P1 and P2
selection: lowest mean CRPS, FBS-vs-FBS regular season 2014-2019 (2013 burn-in)
score_window: 2021-2025 FBS-vs-FBS regular season (third look at this window for the Glicko family)
holdout: one read of 2026 weeks 1-7 completed FBS-vs-FBS regular-season games: P2 minus P1 paired CRPS and MAE only. No market data, no P1 beta (P1's sealed confirmation untouched).
adopt_rule: 2021-25 paired CRPS improves (CI below 0) AND 2021-25 MAE not worse (CI upper <= 0 or CI contains 0) AND 2026 wk1-7 CRPS diff <= 0 AND 2021-25 CRPS improvement holds in every one-step stress neighbour of the P2 pick
calibration_fix: sigma_pred is reported separately; it changes intervals and win probabilities, never means or ranks
